title: MAT Hive Definition — bundle manifest
description: Machine-readable index for MAT-49. Defines the schema for Hive top-level orchestration.
notes: Hive definitions are JSON files in the hives/ directory (parallel to crews/ and swarms/).
crews[].ref must resolve to crews/{ref}.json on disk.
depends_on defines a DAG of crew sequencing; circular dependencies are rejected by validate_hive.py.
global_config quotas are parsed in v1; enforcement is deferred to MAT-50 runtime.
Swarm integration in Hive is deferred to v2.
